Short title and commencement

THE PORT QASIM AUTHORITY (AMENDMENTS) ACT, 2021
THE
PORT QASIM AUTHORITY (AMENDMENTS) ACT, 2021
[AS PASSED BY THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY]
A
Bill
further
to amend the Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973 (XLIII of 1973),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
l. Short title and commencement. -
(1) This Act shall be called the Port Qasim Authority (Amendments) Act, 2021.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

1973. - In the Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973 CXLIII of 1973), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 2, after clause (r), the following new
clause shall be inserted, namely:-
(fa)
division concerned means the Minister of the Division to which the business
of the Authority stands allocated; .
